reason: This would sit directly in our trade path, and an early-stage vendor with no customers and no SOC 2 report can't get through our vendor review, even for a free pilot. My engineers already rate-limit every API key, so the urgency isn't high enough to make an exception.
objection: Putting an unaudited startup's proxy between our customers' agents and order execution means its outages and security gaps become ours, with no references to tell me how it holds up. On top of that, per-action pricing is hard to budget once agent volume starts spiking.
would_change_my_mind: A completed SOC 2 Type II report plus two or three references from regulated brokers or neobanks already running it in production, with a flat annual price instead of per-action overages.
